tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Sequences and physicochemical properties of N1 and its analogues.
footnotes: Note: MW: molecular weight; PI: isoelectric point; GRAVY: grand average of hydropathicity; underlined residues: the modified residues. AI: aliphatic index; BI: Boman index; AAS: antibacterial activity score; S-S: disulfide bonds. N1, N2, N3 and N4: the “rocket” analogues with two disulfide bonds of Cys3-20 and Cys7-16; N6: the “kite” analogue with one disulfide bond of Cys7-16; N7: the “bullet” analogue with one disulfide bond of Cys3-20; N5 and N8: the other analogues without disulfide bonds.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.caption: The MIC values of N1 and its analogues.
footnotes: Note: NA: no detection. aChina Veterinary Culture Collection Center (CVCC); bChina Center of Industrial Culture Collection (CICC); cAmerican Type Culture Collection (ATCC); dNational Center Center for Medical Culture Collection (CMCC). Data were representative of three independent experiments.

tables.label: Table 3
tables.caption: Structure statistics for 20 conformers of the three peptides N1, N2 and N6.
footnotes: None of the structures exhibits distance violations greater than 0.3 Å or dihedral angle violations greater than 4˚. aThe program PROCHECK (http://www.biochem.ucl.ac.uk/~roman/procheck_nmr/procheck_nmr.html) was used to assess the overall quality of the structures; bThe numbers in the parenthesis are the rms differences for the well-ordered region (residues 3–20 for N1, residues 2–20 for N2, and residues 3–19 for N6).
